author: Matt Wolfe
description:
AI companies want your data so badly that we may be entering the era where they just start paying you for it. 👀

I came across a company called Verb that lets you choose what data you’re willing to share, block certain companies, and even set your own price.

And I think this could become a much bigger trend.

As people get more protective of their data—but AI companies need more of it for training and advertising—the solution might simply become: pay people directly.

Obviously, there are some MASSIVE privacy questions here.

So I’m curious: Would you sell your data to big tech if the price was right? 

#AI #Ainews #chatgpt
title: This Company Will Buy Your AI Training Data
